# Burning Springs: Odd Looking Rock

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

Fast Travel Point:

- Westbrook Horse Ranch

Directions:

From the spawn in this location, run forward and jump up onto the roof of the large red and white barn.

Face southeast and run past the large tree on your left and the water pump on your right. Keep going, jump the fence, and continue running until you reach the white horse trailer. Climb onto the trailer and face east. You’ll see a rock face ahead with a yellow sand path leading up the face.

Follow the path up to the top and follow it to the end. Turn right and look down. You will see the Odd Looking Rock inventory window in front of you.

__Rewards__

1x Stimpak

1x Bubblegum

3x Basic Junk

2x Rare Junk

1x Contextual Ammo
